title: Should — giving advice
examples: If I were you, I would call the hotel.
explanation: Use should to give advice or say what is a good idea. Soften advice with If I were you or I suggest.
explanationIt: Usa should per dare consigli o dire cosa è una buona idea. Ammorbidisci con If I were you o I suggest.
realUse: You shouldn't leave your bag unattended.
If I were you, I would call the hotel first.

exercises.explanation: After should, use the base form (book).

exercises.prompt: You ____ arrive at the station early.
Fix: You should to call them.
